The Chinese characters for Connor

As a transliteration, Connor is usually written 康纳 (Kāng nà). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

Origin and meaning

With Irish origins, Connor is usually read as “lover of hounds”.

About the name Connor

An Irish name meaning 'lover of hounds', carried by many a king of Connacht.

As a gift or a tattoo

If you are choosing a name for a print or a tattoo, Connor carries the meaning “lover of hounds” and looks striking in brush strokes.
